messages:
anna (People Ops): FYI new manager (Diego Alvarez) starts Mon 07/22. I sketched a tiny first-week manager checklist to reduce meeting noise. Feedback pls.

miles (Hiring Manager): Thx. Can we keep week 1 focused: context, access, and one concrete deliverable? Also want a short hiring sync on Day 2.

tess (Eng Manager): Agree. Please include a 45m architecture + runtime primer and a 30m Redwood Console demo.

rahul (IT): I'll order laptop and pre-create Okta + GitHub access. Need OS + shipping addr. Will attach ticket ID once created.

onboard-bot: Auto-assign: Manager security + compliance modules. Completion target: Day 3.

samir (Buddy): I'll DM Diego and set a 20-min coffee Day 1 and 15-min check-ins Days 2-4. Also will pin a short "how we ship" doc in #team-onboarding.

anna (People Ops): Compact agenda (actionable):
- Pre-day: device shipped, SSO invites, calendar blocks for: ops intro, tech primer, manager 1:1.
- Day 1: 30m People Ops (benefits/org), 45m team kickoff, 20m buddy coffee, 30m manager kickoff (expectations).
- Day 2: 45m architecture + 30m Redwood Console + 30m hiring debrief.
- Day 3: 60m hands-on local dev + security quickstart.
- Day 4: 60m paired work on a small onboarding ticket.
- Day 5: 60m draft 30/60/90, 30m People Ops wrap.

Quick owners: IT (rahul): device + SSO; Hiring Manager (miles): debrief + first project; Buddy (samir): welcome + daily syncs; People Ops (anna): calendar + benefits packet.

30/60/90 (short):
30-day: ramp, local dev, ship small fix.
60-day: own a minor feature/process.
90-day: measurable outcome aligned to team OKRs.

miles (Hiring Manager): Please add a 30-45m customer-shadow slot Day 3 afternoon if possible.

anna (People Ops): Noted. Miles, please DM shipping address + OS preference to Rahul by EOD so invites go out. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
